notes: H0 only; 0.5 s per row for all ten heats.
Four gas-defined stages are retrospective diagnostic pseudo-labels.
Test stage routing uses training-only median time or oxygen thresholds.
All model comparisons use nested leave-one-heat-out folds.
The stage-4 lag profile is weak and must not be interpreted as physical transport time.
Full point predictions are regenerated by the CLI and are not frozen in this commit.
